title: Password entered on a phishing page ten minutes ago

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

input.subject: I think I clicked something I shouldn't have

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
Hi,

I got an email that looked like it was from Greg asking me to check a payroll
summary. I clicked the link and it took me to a Microsoft sign-in page so I
put my password in. It then said the page had expired and nothing happened,
which is when I thought it looked wrong.

That was about ten minutes ago. I haven't touched anything since.

Mel

handling.escalation_reason: A likely credential compromise in progress.

rationale: She typed her password into a fake Microsoft page: a confirmed credential compromise, which the priority definitions name as P1. On-call, now.
